answer: A karst survey and a pearl valuation may be unrelated jobs, but each must reserve a fixed bond until its dispute window closes. The ledger permits only one live job per bond and binds receipts to a unique task ID, rejecting replays. Splitting funds across fake agents cannot increase total bonded capacity. A flood therefore locks proportionally more capital; proven duplicate claims forfeit the bond. This limits the ripple of cheap identities, not wealthy attackers or colluding judges.
